name: looker-omni-migration
description: Plan a Looker to Omni migration before you move a single explore. Skills that map LookML explores and joins as a risk-scored ERD, trace dashboard to explore to view lineage, and decide which joins to materialize in the warehouse, convert LookML views and explores into Omni model files, plus a Looker System Activity query for sizing and finding UGC dashboards.
